Title: Microsoft Entra ID: Risk-based anti-bot verification (CAPTCHA) for SMS and voice authentication
Summary: Microsoft Entra ID is adding risk-based CAPTCHA verification for SMS and voice first-factor sign-ins to reduce automated abuse. Rollout began mid-October 2026. Some users may encounter this step based on behavior. Organizations should prepare help desks, review network requirements, and encourage phishing-resistant methods like passkeys.
